title: Capture useful evidence
summary: A screenshot records visible state. It helps explain a failure but is not a replacement for a precise behaviour check.
introduction: A screenshot records visible state. It helps explain a failure but is not a replacement for a precise behaviour check. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Capture useful evidence

blocks.text: The test checks the heading and saves a screenshot in the local test project.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Choose a meaningful file name for a search-result screenshot.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not approve changed visual snapshots without looking at the changes.
For more detail later, use this [Playwright further reading](https://playwright.dev/docs/intro).
